listing.name: THREAT DETECTED
listing.aiSummary: Adds a challenging scenario featuring fabricators and fleet production limits.

description: Adds a scenario where fabricators are prioritized and explode if more than two exist. The maximum producible DP is roughly double the fleet's expected amount. The mod was nerfed to be beatable in its final version.
